result.markdown:
The best payroll software depends on where your business operates, how many employees you have, and whether you need payroll, superannuation, tax reporting and timesheets all in one place.

**If you're operating in Australia, my top recommendation would be Xero Payroll for businesses already using Xero, or MYOB for a smaller business wanting a straightforward payroll solution.**

Here's how I'd compare the leading options.

## Best payroll software for small businesses in Australia

![Xero Review: Beautiful cloud accounting for small businesses](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/zGt9HgpMco6i_cEW4Fs2z4PfaYnsmZs5tPfBUXsnllkv1BJub0fQjmBDPN6Tj_rhsmDrvtCTN1sy6j8MlElBMhgWnLS-E6YtgVna7212YJZ450WRilWWBa0zxHPN0xUPvL1bReO96RNQcOlASZXYIFWdl7ErEK4L1kcoJAb3DRFhlKyCQY0Myx8ZoJTQoUTJ?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall for Xero users)

- Payroll integrated with accounting.
- Single Touch Payroll (STP) reporting.
- Superannuation processing.
- Leave management and payslips.
- Good for businesses wanting everything connected.

Website: [Xero Australia](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for small businesses)

- Payroll and employee management.
- STP compliance.
- Superannuation management.
- Leave and award interpretation options.
- Good Australian business support.

Website: [MYOB Australia](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Employment Hero - Which HR Software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hoOMaIHHE1BVK8wWyswfFUWF-4zNLm2VTTf8I0IsZi71QvwwVg013JN6PZd_JzmKlLo5GMH1Nn9Dlq8Awe3_MYWQTya_RX2YJlpU2kxq0LmTpktkVrYam4C6Jqjid1iaOedcQ7rhD-uZbRDBcKqCEBszhJOC_eRUB4bTTF7gnOKcGZ7dKIuzDzdg-ruuRgJy?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Employment Hero**

(Best for HR and payroll together)

- Payroll and employee onboarding.
- Leave and attendance management.
- HR documentation.
- Employee self-service.
- Useful as your workforce grows.

Website: [Employment Hero](https://employmenthero.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon**

(Best for affordability)

- Straightforward payroll processing.
- STP reporting.
- Employee leave tracking.
- Superannuation functionality.
- Worth considering for smaller teams.

Website: [Reckon Australia](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/v2DxdxtjjvEmcT175Hs6YVBjgbAAlKMZDR6USs-77ApdWW6sbAFow9cQJv_MT97jB9zjE3wPxOpKSO9gcLLxLfFypeZvyP5eJvDL5WGyfBsSIqIhU81GbrWMoq4pqjRGs2-V3Eb0qoi-t3xsMSUPgetkp-nB9-Vn5YkmqvxZsrEUOfyJgwiq9_ZT3tLhuZte?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Payroller**

(Best for very small businesses)

- Simple payroll processing.
- STP reporting.
- Employee payslips.
- Mobile-friendly.
- Particularly appealing for businesses with only a few employees.

Website: [Payroller](https://payroller.com.au/)

## My comparison

| Software | Best suited to |
|--------|--------|
| Xero | Accounting and payroll together |
| MYOB | Small business payroll |
| Employment Hero | Payroll and HR |
| Reckon | Budget-conscious businesses |
| Payroller | Micro businesses |


## What I'd look for

For an Australian small business, make sure your payroll software supports\:

- STP Phase 2 reporting to the ATO.
- Superannuation processing and SuperStream.
- PAYG withholding.
- Annual leave and personal leave accruals.
- Award rates and penalty rates, where applicable.
- Employee timesheets and rostering.
- Easy integration with your accounting software.
